nickBadge.menu.screenInfo: Status and how to get a badge
nickBadge.menu.showInfo: GCONNECT badges next to names: in chats, the chat list, contacts and profiles. The badge list is downloaded from badges.gconnect.cc — no data about you is sent
nickBadge.screen.info: Your badge is shown next to your name to everyone who uses Ghostgram with badges turned on. It goes to the Telegram account that paid for it in @{bot}. One payment, the badge stays forever.
nickBadge.screen.offFooter: Badges are turned off. Turn on «Show badges» to see your badge and other people's.
